concepts.meaning: An explicitly named public data shape owned by one Interface and reusable by several members; neither an Entity nor a Value Object.
One declared Operation or Query exposure with an explicit request and result type; referencing a public contract does not execute the member.
An exact local contract reference or explicitly shared domain value type, never a field-name inference or internal Entity leak.
Pure source-specialized shape normalization, distinct from domain construction, invariant execution, transport and version eligibility.

distinctions: contract identity versus consuming member identity
public contract versus Value Object invariant
local contract reference versus domain named value
